task_text: Turn off the room light, turn on faucet

central_instructions.R1: Move to the bedroom light switch and turn off the light.
central_instructions.R2: Move to the bathroom faucet and turn it on.
central_instructions.R3: Assist R1 if needed in turning off the bedroom light.
central_instructions.R4: Assist R2 if needed in turning on the bathroom faucet.
